'''Celebrain''' is a woman who is placed in the army of Queen [[Elayne Trakand]] during the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|37}}

== Activities ==
When [[Demandred]] announces that he is hunting Elayne, [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte Trahelion]] orders Celebrain to serve as Elayne's decoy, and has her raise a banner posing as Elayne and ride in the opposing direction. This is effectively a death sentence for Celebrain.{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Celebrain is named after fan Per-Kristian Buer, who went by the username ''Celebrían'', the name of a character in ''The Lord of the Rings''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
